title: TheologicalValidation
description: Records the result of consulting Biblical concordances and dictionaries to verify the theological accuracy and thematic alignment of a financially-themed ScriptureRecord. Produced by 'theological_validator' subagents as the final quality gate before records are seeded to the BibleFi dApp.

validation_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this theological validation record (UUID v4).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the TheologicalValidation schema (e.g. '1.0.0').

scripture_record_id.description: UUID of the ScriptureRecord this validation pertains to.

cross_language_validation_id.description: UUID of the CrossLanguageValidation record that preceded this theological check. Theological validation should only be performed on records that have already passed cross-language validation.

concordance_references.description: References from Biblical concordances that support or qualify the financial theme of this passage.

entry.description: The concordance entry or heading under which this passage appears (e.g. 'Money', 'Debt', 'Riches', 'Stewardship').

items.description: Canonical Bible references listed alongside this entry (e.g. 'Matthew 6:24', 'Luke 16:11').

related_passages.description: Other scripture references cross-listed under the same concordance entry, providing thematic context.

relevance.description: How directly this concordance entry supports the financial theme classification.

notes.description: Optional commentary on the concordance reference.

dictionary_definitions.description: Definitions from Biblical dictionaries or lexicons for key terms in this passage.

dictionary.description: Name of the Biblical dictionary or lexicon consulted.
examples: Baker's Evangelical Dictionary of Biblical Theology
TDNT (Theological Dictionary of the New Testament)

term.description: The Biblical term being defined (in English or original language).

definition.description: The dictionary's definition of the term, capturing its theological and contextual meaning.

financial_significance.description: Explanation of how this term's definition confirms or illuminates the financial theme of the passage.

strongs_number.description: Optional Strong's reference number for the defined term.

thematic_alignment.description: Overall assessment of how well this passage aligns with the BibleFi financial theme.

primary_theme.description: The dominant financial theme identified for this passage (e.g. 'debt', 'stewardship', 'generosity', 'wealth', 'poverty', 'tithing', 'usury').

secondary_themes.description: Additional financial sub-themes present in the passage.

dapp_category.description: The BibleFi dApp category under which this scripture should be displayed (e.g. 'Debt & Borrowing', 'Giving & Tithing', 'Wealth Management', 'Stewardship', 'Contentment').

alignment_score.description: Numeric score representing how strongly this passage supports the financial theme (0.0 = no alignment, 1.0 = perfect alignment).

contextual_notes.description: Theological commentary on the passage's financial theme within its broader Biblical context.

overall_status.description: Aggregate theological validation outcome. 'validated' means concordances and dictionaries confirm the financial theme; 'requires_review' means human theological oversight is recommended before seeding.

reviewer_notes.description: Optional notes from a human theological reviewer, if manual oversight was applied.

validated_by_agent.description: Identifier of the 'theological_validator' agent instance that produced this record.

task_id.description: UUID of the AgentTask that generated this validation record.

validated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this validation was completed.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was last updated.

tags.description: Optional tags for filtering or categorisation.

concordance_references.notes: Listed under 'debt' and 'borrower' entries. The passage is a primary proof-text for the principle that indebtedness creates relational obligation.

dictionary_definitions.definition: One who takes on a financial obligation from another, creating a binding relational and legal duty to repay.
dictionary_definitions.financial_significance: Confirms that the borrower-lender dynamic in this passage carries explicit financial and social weight in the ancient Near Eastern context.

thematic_alignment.contextual_notes: Proverbs 22:7 is one of the clearest statements in Scripture on the relational consequences of debt. Its inclusion in the BibleFi dApp's 'Debt & Borrowing' category is well-supported by multiple concordances and lexicons.
